subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option for the given blank.

Don't _______ faith, everything will be all right.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"lose" i**s the correct choice for the sentence.
 
• **"Lose"** means to be deprived of or cease to have something, which fits the context of losing faith.
 
• The option** "loose"** is incorrect as it means not tight or free, which doesn't fit the context.
 
• The options** "raises"** and "give" do not fit grammatically in the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Don't **lose** faith, everything will be all right."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lose:** To be deprived of or cease to have something.
 
• **Loose:** Not tight or free.
 
• **Raises:** To lift or move to a higher position or level.
 
• **Give:** To freely transfer the possession of something to someone.
